label: Softs class plan
qualitativeProtocols: Softs (cocoa, coffee, sugar, cotton) are weather- and origin-policy-driven, and markets are thin - single orders and margin changes move price independent of fundamentals.
The engine cannot read weather nowcasts, arrivals data, grind reports, or origin-country policy; these are declared, not executed.
Thin open interest exaggerates moves - bands should be treated as wide.
